title: REQ · Startup releases a stale lock file before recovery
summary: Recoverer.Startup removes a lock file older than StaleAfter, then runs Recover.
description: Context: lock.Acquire writes a PID file that a crashed process never removes, blocking runner.Run with ErrLocked. Desired behavior: Startup inspects the lock file modification time through an injected LockFS and removes it when now minus modtime exceeds StaleAfter. Expected result: Startup returns whether a lock was released together with the Recover result. Why: a crash must not block the worker forever.
acceptance_criteria: Given a lock modtime older than StaleAfter, When Startup runs, Then LockFS.Remove is called with LockPath and Result.LockReleased is true
Given a lock modtime younger than StaleAfter, When Startup runs, Then Remove is not called and LockReleased is false
Given the lock file does not exist, When Startup runs, Then no error is returned and Recover still runs
Given Remove fails, When Startup runs, Then Startup returns an error wrapping it and does not resume executions
technical_constraints: StaleAfter must exceed Timeout times attempts; documented in code comment
dependencies: Recoverer type from the scan requirement (same package)
